heading: Availability of facilities and appropriations
lead: The services and facilities of and appropriations for the Coast Guard shall be available to effectuate the purposes of the Reserve and the Auxiliary.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Based on title 14, U.S.C., 1946 ed., § 354 (Feb. 19, 1941, ch. 8, title III, § 304, 55 Stat. 14). Changes were made in phraseology. 81st Congress, House Report No. 557.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 894 of this title as this section.
